text: A direct, quantitative question answerable from computed metrics - momentum, velocity, price, stock levels, rankings. No reasoning or explanation is required, just retrieve and sort or filter numbers.
which styles are trending right now
what is the average price for graphic tees across competitors
which competitor SKUs have been out of stock the most in the last 4 weeks
what is our best-selling style this month
which style has the fastest growing rating velocity
A why question asking for the reason behind a trend or number. Needs the structured momentum data plus supporting evidence - specific posts or products - to explain the cause.
why is the cropped zip-up jacket declining
why has this style lost momentum
what is driving the graphic print trend
why are competitors losing traction on this style
what is causing this style to decline
A question phrased in aesthetic or vibe language that falls outside the fixed style_tag taxonomy - requires similarity search over free text rather than exact tag matching.
show me anything y2k adjacent or nostalgic in what is trending
what feels like elevated basics versus loud streetwear
is there anything similar to oversized hoodies gaining traction that we have not tagged yet
find styles with a vintage or throwback vibe
what has a minimalist aesthetic right now
A forward-looking recommendation question about what to do next, combining trend data, aesthetic signal, and brand-fit reasoning.
what should our next collection focus on
should we invest in this style for next season
what is the single biggest opportunity we are missing right now
what would you recommend we prioritize next
where should we place our bets next quarter
